name: Color Vault VR: Hidden Bottles
summary:
Enter a futuristic color vault where logic is your only key.

Every numbered box hides one color. Grab the complete set of bottles, arrange them on the boxes, and press CHECK ARRANGEMENT. The vault reveals only a single clue: how many bottles are in the exact correct position. It never tells you which ones. Study your attempt history, spot the pattern, refine the order, and solve the vault.

Start with a guided 3-bottle tutorial, then choose:

• Easy — 5 bottles
• Medium — 7 bottles
• Hard — 11 bottles acro
